label: December 7–13, 2026
intro: A four-day Christmas funfair, more gingerbread building and a meteor shower to finish the week.

activities.title: Christmas Festival Bangkok 2026 (German-style market + funfair)
activities.why: Rides, a playground, Santa and festive food — a full day out for the whole family.
activities.tip: Go Thursday or Friday evening to dodge weekend crowds; BTS Bang Na.

activities.title: Kimpton Maa-Lai gingerbread house workshop
activities.why: Another chance to build a gingerbread house — maybe an Iron Man-red one this time.

activities.title: Bangkok Uncovered & Beyond Christmas Market
activities.why: A relaxed, leafy garden market with treats and gifts.

activities.title: Fun Factory Christmas classes
activities.why: Christmas-themed hands-on craft classes — good rainy-day making time.

activities.title: Geminid meteor shower — NARIT viewing night
activities.location: NARIT regional observatories (nearest: Chachoengsao) or any dark open spot
activities.why: Up to 150 shooting stars an hour — real space science, just like Tony Stark's sky scanners.
activities.tip: Best after midnight but even an hour before bedtime outside the city is fun; bring a mat.

activities.title: Vijit Chao Phraya — final nights
activities.location: Riverfront sites along the Chao Phraya
activities.why: Last chance for the river light show.

activities.title: Onederous Christmas at One Bangkok
activities.why: Giant tree, photo spots and festive music.
